Marcus — thanks for the context and the redlines. I reviewed Amble's asks and prepared a marked MSA with suggested language and negotiation notes. Attached: MSA_Amble_redline_20260807.docx. Summary of our proposed positions: 

1) Data retention/export: Counter with a balanced clause — Redwood will provide export of customer‑provided content within 30 days of request and will delete derived customer data within 90 days after customer confirms export completion. Include an exception for backups and residuals (standard language) and require customer to submit export requests through the Console + ticket for audit trail. This keeps a clear operational path and limits open‑ended obligations.

2) SOC2 attestation: Acceptable to include an annual attestation clause referencing our SOC2 report (we will not provide raw audit artifacts). Propose language that permits "upon reasonable request, Redwood will provide current SOC2 Type II attestation or other compliance documentation subject to NDA".

3) Termination/notice: We should avoid unilateral shortening of convenience notice to 30 days across the board. Proposed compromise: 45 days convenience notice for this renewal only + mutual termination for material breach with a 15‑day cure (we can reduce to 10 if NDA/specific carveouts are present). Reason: 30 days is aggressive operationally and increases churn risk; 45 days is a defensible middle ground.

Pricing tradeoff: If Sales is willing to offer pricing concession for the 18‑month term (e.g., 2.5% discount across committed capacity or 1 month free applied over first 6 months), legal can accept the above compromise. Confirm which concession you want so I can reflect in the order form.

Next steps I recommend: 
- Marcus to propose the concession (if any) and confirm ramp schedule.
- I will produce a consolidated redline (MSA + Order Form) and upload to DocuSign for signature if Amble accepts.

DocuSign draft link (internal): https://www.docusign.com/link/embedded/ampsig-20260808

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
